items.item_text: Under close supervision, the Assistant Animal Technician (Cage Wash) performs tasks to support the cage wash areas on campus, including but not limited to cage scrapping, cage and accessories washing, and packing.
Ability to lift 50 pounds and to push 200–300-pound cage racks of animals.
Ability to communicate in English, verbally and in writing, accurately and timely
Basic computer knowledge and skills to complete online training sessions
Knowledge of and ability to accurately follow all SOPs, Working Instructions, Forms, Training Checklists associated with the cage wash area
Ability to participate in weekend/Holiday work rotations and occasional overtime duties
Working knowledge of cage wash equipment included but not limited to rack and tunnel washers, bedding dispenses, bedding vacuums, water filling stations, and sterilizers
Knowledge of safety practices in the cage wash are including but not limited to ergonomics, thermal and allergy risks.
Knowledge of all the cage wash areas and the equipment in each of them, sufficient to organize, sort and process soiled items, and pack clean equipment in an efficient and safe manner.
Knowledge of cleaning and sanitizing materials and techniques sufficient to maintain a healthful environment.
Ability to maintain records following proper documentation practices
